zoe: FYI onboarding sampleapp failing on rerank after we turned on the new SDK autogroup/batching and transparent retry. Getting "RerankError: vector length mismatch (expected 768, got 767)" for a tiny subset of inputs.

zoe: minimal repro (python):
```py
# sdk v1.6.0 with auto-retry on
batch = batcher.group(docs, 6)[0]
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-lite', input=batch)
# immediately send to rerank
res = client.rerank.create(queries=queries, candidates=resp.data)
```

harun: can you log whether resp.data[].embedding is an array or embedding_bytes? Also any HTTP 401/5xx around the time? Retries + stateful batchers sometimes cause partial payloads.

zoe: logged a failing run: resp.data shows embedding_bytes for two items and embedding arrays for others. The failing item had embedding_bytes length %4 == 3 -> 767 floats. I also see an auth 401 returned by the proxy right before a retry.

mira: that combination is telling: when the transport layer retried (after 401), the batcher returned a mutated shorter list and the embeddings path took the bytes path for small items, and one of the bytes payloads lost a padding byte due to the chunker using buffer.length instead of byteLength. Result: mixed formats + one truncated vector.

harun: thanks. Quick mitigation: 1) in sampleapp, normalize both fields before rerank: if embedding_bytes present, pad to mod-4 and decode to float array; if embedding array present, assert length. 2) disable transparent retry for embeddings calls until SDK patch lands.

zoe: local hack worked (pad + decode) and CI is green.

mira: actions: devex will cut patch to batcher to return immutable chunk copies, patch the bytes serializer to use byteLength everywhere, and add a defensive normalize() helper in all SDKs. Also adding server-side diagnostics for rerank dim errors (include expected/got/field/bytes_mod_4).

sdk-bot: Created INF-8042: "batcher+serializer: padding bug + retry interaction -> truncated embedding_bytes" assigned to @mira.

zoe: thanks. leaving notes in sampleapp README about the normalization step and to upgrade SDK when INF-8042 lands. :thumbsup:
